newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota to boost 96/97 capital investment - paper.
newsitem.headline: Toyota to boost 96/97 capital investment - paper.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp will raise its capital investment by 30 billion yen to 330 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, a Japanese newspaper said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun financial daily said on Sunday that the revision was due to an increase in investment for the development of new models. Toyota also aims to improve its competitiveness by implementing some of the projects which the company originally planned for the next business year, the paper said. Toyota plans to introduce 13 or 14 models in 1996/97, the largest number the company has ever launched in a single year, the paper said.
Toyota officials were not immediately available for comment.
